"""BEHAVIOR-1K limited-mode garden cleanup controller."""
import json
import os
import time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/output"
RUNS = os.path.join(OUT, "runs")
os.makedirs(RUNS, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
obs = r.get_obs()
print("INITIAL_META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
for cam, im in obs.last.items():
    from PIL import Image
    Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(OUT, cam.replace(":", "_") + ".jpg"))

def status():
    s = r.status()
    print(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
    return s

def observe(seconds=0.0, video="frames"):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    print("OBS_META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(OUT, cam.replace(":", "_") + ".jpg"))
    return obs

def joints(rows, dt=1/30, **kwargs):
    global obs
    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, **kwargs)
    print("ACTION_META", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    obs = res
    for cam, im in res.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(OUT, cam.replace(":", "_") + ".jpg"))
    return res

def ee(rows, **kwargs):
    global obs
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), **kwargs)
    print("ACTION_META", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    obs = res
    for cam, im in res.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(OUT, cam.replace(":", "_") + ".jpg"))
    return res

def save_run(name):
    return obs.save(os.path.join(RUNS, name))
